story.titleZh: 劳森因更换动力单元和调整设置，今日将从维修区起步 #F1 #墨西哥站
story.summaryZh: 劳森因更换动力单元和调整设置，今日将从维修区起步。尽管车队自行披露违规，但 stewards 确认劳森被取消排位赛成绩。
story.originalTitle: Lawson will now start from the pit lane today after taking a new PU and making set-up changes #F1 #MexicoGP
story.summaryEn:
Lawson will now start from the pit lane today after taking a new PU and making set-up changes #F1 #MexicoGPChris Medland: Confirmed: Lawson is disqualified from the qualifying results, despite his team self-disclosing the breach
The stewards note there are a number of precedents that means a technical infringement has to be disqualification #F1 #MexicoGP
